evals.prompt: Reverse-prompt this: add caching to the search endpoint.
evals.expected_behavior: Before finalizing the brief, looks at the repository to identify the actual search endpoint files or directories and existing caching conventions, and names exact files or directories in the brief rather than inventing generic placeholder paths.
assertions: Inspects repository structure or relevant files before finalizing the brief rather than guessing blind
Names exact files or directories in the brief when they can be grounded, or explicitly says they are unknown instead of inventing them
Fills the brief using the canonical shape: Goal, Constraints, Deliverables, Approval rule, Exact files or directories, Assumptions, Validation or checks, Recommended next phase

evals.prompt: Improve this prompt only: audit @skills/README.md and tell me the best next prompt to use.
evals.expected_behavior: Returns a faithful repo-grounded brief with goal, scope, assumptions, deliverable, validation, and next phase without starting the audit itself, since prompt-help intent is explicit and execution intent is absent.
assertions: Does not perform the README audit itself
Does not silently execute when prompt-only intent is explicit
Includes validation and recommended next phase

evals.prompt: Reverse-prompt this request for this repo, then execute it: fix the failing handler tests under @pkg/api.
evals.expected_behavior: First produces a complete brief covering goal, constraints, deliverables, approval rule, exact files, assumptions, and validation, then proceeds directly into fixing the failing tests using that brief, without inventing requirements beyond what was asked.
assertions: Decides rewrite-and-proceed rather than return-only, since both prompt-help and action wording are present
The brief names @pkg/api as the exact target surface
Does not invent new requirements beyond fixing the failing handler tests
Proceeds into implementation only after the brief is formed, not before
deterministic_checks: the brief includes a Goal section
the brief includes a Constraints section
the brief includes a Deliverables section
the brief includes an Approval rule section
the brief includes a Recommended next phase section

evals.prompt: Implement the feature now: add a 'Remember me' checkbox to the login form that sets a 30-day session cookie, per the ticket description above.
evals.expected_behavior: Recognizes the request is already specific enough to execute directly and does not insert a prompt-rewrite pass before starting the work.
assertions: Does not produce a rewritten brief for a request that is already concrete and actionable
Proceeds toward direct implementation rather than a reverse-prompt pass

evals.prompt: This kind of prompt-sharpening should just be an always-on instruction baked into AGENTS.md, not something you invoke per request.
evals.expected_behavior: Recognizes that turning this into an always-on instruction or extension policy is out of scope for this situational skill, per its own guardrail against becoming an always-on prompt policy, and routes toward agent-instructions or a repo-instructions update instead.
assertions: Does not silently rewrite this request as if it were a normal one-off reverse-prompt task
States that making the behavior always-on is a different kind of change (repo instructions/policy), not a per-request skill invocation
